none: PAS LANCUM-5F0F12: LANCUM-5F0F12: Roman finger ring of Type Henig IX
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Cast copper-alloy finger ring of Henig Type XI and dating from the Roman period. The ring is octagonal in shape with eight faces, all of which are undecorated. The ring is bent out of shape and the surface heavily corroded. An image of the ring was seen by M. Henig and he adds: "There are some of these rings which are inscribed (cf RIB II fascicule 6) but no sign of that here. My ring types were…
